sloka: स्व बलम् समुपाश्रित्य नीता वशम् अरिम् दम ।मायाः च अधिगतास् तत्र बहवो राक्षस अधिप ॥६-७-११॥।।
transliteration: sva balam samupāśritya nītā vaśam arim dama ।māyāḥ ca adhigatās tatra bahavo rākṣasa adhipa ॥6-7-11॥।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed king Going to the subterranean world, you won over the serpent demons Vasuki, Takshaka, Shanka and Jati and made them submit to you."
